caption: Aggressive orchestral boom bap with brass stabs, pounding taiko drums and a dark choir, instrumental at 90 BPM in C minor. Mood: relentless, triumphant, final-round energy. Like a fighting game soundtrack recorded by a hip-hop producer with live session players: hard live drums with a tight snare and trap hi-hat rolls, a deep 808 bass, a concert grand piano, real bells and a warm analog synth pad. Big, polished studio mix with natural reverb, instrumental, no vocals.
lyrics:
[Intro - solo grand piano and ringing bells]

[Verse - hard live drums and deep 808 bass come in]

[Hook - full arrangement, bells and synth pad swell]

[Outro - piano and bells alone]
style: aggressive orchestral boom bap with brass stabs, pounding taiko drums and a dark choir
